subject: design/feature-draft
statement: Fold each draft-born plan against the immutable memory snapshot at its Basis lock.
intent: Keep plan traces, decisions, and coverage bound to the version that authorized the plan.
rationale: Plangate resolves the Basis tag to one commit, loads active requirement and design records from that tree, and applies the existing plan gates plus complete locked requirement coverage.
fit_criterion: A plan folds without PRD or design files; unknown and retired traces refuse; an earlier plan survives a later retirement; a projection defect leaves the lock unchanged.
